title: Crystals & Saves
notes: Save slots: a main menu with 3 saves. Your current progress was moved into Slot 1 automatically.
Esc menu (or the ☰ button): resume, save, export and import save codes, settings, check for updates, back to the main menu. It pauses battles.
Save codes: export copies a code to your clipboard. Paste it on any device to get your save back.
Everyone who opens the link has their own saves in their own browser.
Skills are now used by you, not automatically. Auto skills can be switched on in the menu once the Gate Map unlocks.
New skill system: Breaker Crystals. Hit and defeat enemies to charge up to 5 crystals, then spend 1, 2 or 3 on a skill.
Use skills back-to-back for a CHAIN bonus of up to +45% damage. Skill buttons charge up visibly and glow when ready.
New patches now pop up in the middle of the screen and leave a banner until you update. Your version is shown in the corner.
